mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline in periods when UNRATE > 6% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline in periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline when INDPRO exceeds 12-month MA by >2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over three months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline when PAYEMS exceeds 12-month MA by >1% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline when GDPC1 exceeds 12-month MA by >2% for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline in periods when UNRATE > 6% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
